hero.eyebrow: Connecting Teen Minds to Wetland Science
hero.title: Welcome to the Global Youth Wetland Research Platform — Linking young minds to wetland science
hero.body: Wetlands are where water meets land and sustain life together. This platform gathers global wetland knowledge, research projects, mentor resources, and opportunities for action—helping youth move from understanding wetlands to real scientific exploration.
